description: This Java class 'VerifyPickSession' manages the verification process for picking items in a shipment system, including creating pick rows, verifying quantities, creating shipments, and updating product info within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: VerifyPickSession
classes.description: Manages the process of verifying pick items, creating shipment, and updating product info within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: createRow
methods.description: Creates a pick verification row for a specific order item, handling inventory reservations and quantity checks.

methods.name: findOrderItemSeqId
methods.description: Finds the order item sequence ID based on product, order, and shipment details.

methods.name: checkRowForAdd
methods.description: Checks if a reservation can hold the requested quantity and updates or creates a pick row accordingly.

methods.name: createVerifyPickRow
methods.description: Creates a new VerifyPickSessionRow based on check results.

methods.name: complete
methods.description: Finalizes the pick verification, creates shipment, issues items, updates products, and updates shipment status.

methods.name: checkReservedQty
methods.description: Verifies that the total verified quantity matches reserved quantity for each order item.

methods.name: issueItemsToShipment
methods.description: Issues verified items to the shipment, consolidating similar items.

methods.name: createShipment
methods.description: Creates a shipment record based on a pick session row.

methods.name: updateProduct
methods.description: Updates product information such as origin geo ID after verification.
